PRH - Changes to patent, SPC, utility model and integrated circuit layout-design fees from 1 January 2026 | PRH


Chan­ges to pa­tent, SPC, uti­li­ty mo­del and in­te­gra­ted circuit lay­out-de­sign fees from 1 Ja­nua­ry 2026
The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment of Finland has issued a new decree (1216/2025) on the chargeable services of the PRH for the period 1 January to 31 December 2026. The fees have been increased to cover the costs in the PRH service groups.
The changes to the patent, SPC, uti­li­ty mo­del and in­te­gra­ted circuit lay­out-de­sign fees are provided below. The previous fee is given in brackets.

the online filing system is used €450 (€430)
the online filing system is not used €580 (€540)
Additional fee for each claim over 15 €60 (€50)
Additional fee for any claim filed after the application was filed, or should be deemed to have been filed, if the total number of claims exceeds the number of the claims for which the application fee has been paid €60 (€50)
Publication fee
the translation has been filed using the online filing system €450 (€430)
the translation has not been filed using the online filing system €580 (€540)
for correction of a translation €580 (€540)
Translation fee €90 per page (€80 per page)

subsequent reinstatements €190 (€160)
